Benzydamine chydrochloride
1-benzylo-3-[3-(dimethylo-amino)-propoxy]-1H-indazole
I have extracted this substance from Tantum Rosa, which also contains 9 grams of salt.
It takes about 1,5 hour before first effects appear like stimulation, strong stimulation like on ephedrine or amphetamine but less pleasant. Than first hallucinations appear. Object's shapes are floating away. Door's spyhole was realistically moving. I was seeing very fast moving flashes of light. The best hallucination appear in the dark. Cats, mice and squirells running around in darker places . Shadows of people. I really enjoyed using benzydamine in dark places for more and stronger visual hallucination.
When I was passing other people on the street, I've heard their throats and I've heard them speaking but they didn't. The stimulation effect causes paranoia and fear. It lasts very long so I can't sleep all night, but even if I could I'd experience nightmares from this drug.
Benzydamine acts very differently than LSD or DXM. More like Datura but strongly stimulating, while datura is more like a depressant and allows you to sleep. Music seems to play very fast on benzydamine.
Benzydamine is popular in Poland. You can buy Tantum Rosa without prescription. It is cheap, but you need two packs at least. One pack with 500 mg costs 3,5 PN with is less than 1 Euro. You can drink it but it's dissgusting, so I suggest you make an easy extraction using water and filters for coffee.
